content.value_statement: Whole slide pathology images are large and difficult to prepare for analysis. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through histolab workflows for inspection, masks, tiles, filters, and visualization.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to load WSI files and inspect dimensions, pyramid levels, magnification, and slide properties.
Guides tissue detection with TissueMask, BiggestTissueBoxMask, BinaryMask, and custom mask workflows.
Compares RandomTiler, GridTiler, and ScoreTiler for sampling, coverage, and quality-based extraction.
Documents preprocessing filters for color conversion, thresholding, morphology, tissue cleanup, and artifact handling.
Shows visualization workflows for thumbnails, masks, tile locations, mosaics, score distributions, and reports.
Provides troubleshooting guidance for missing tiles, background tiles, slow extraction, and inconsistent slide results.
limitations: It does not diagnose disease or replace pathology review.
It depends on the Python histolab library and compatible WSI reader support.
Large slides can require high memory, storage, and processing time.
Examples may need adjustment for local slide formats and staining protocols.

use_cases.title: Build Training Tiles
use_cases.description: Create reproducible tile datasets from many WSI files with masks, thresholds, seeds, and quality review steps.

use_cases.title: Review Tissue Masks
use_cases.description: Select and tune tissue masks for H&E or IHC slides before extracting downstream analysis regions.

use_cases.title: Standardize Slide Processing
use_cases.description: Plan consistent multi-slide workflows with output folders, thumbnails, reports, resource checks, and troubleshooting steps.

prompt_templates.title: Load And Inspect A Slide
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the histolab skill to load my WSI file, inspect dimensions and pyramid levels, and create a thumbnail review plan.

prompt_templates.title: Create Tissue Masks
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through choosing TissueMask or BiggestTissueBoxMask for H&E slides, then preview mask quality before extraction.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Model Training Tiles
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a reproducible RandomTiler workflow for 512 pixel tiles, tissue filtering, CSV reporting, and visual quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize A Multi-Slide Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare RandomTiler, GridTiler, and ScoreTiler for a large cohort, then recommend levels, masks, scoring, and storage controls.

output_examples.input: I need 100 representative tiles from each prostate WSI.
output_examples.output: A RandomTiler workflow with 512 pixel tiles, fixed seed, tissue threshold, thumbnail preview, and review checklist.

output_examples.input: My tissue mask includes background and pen marks.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting plan that adjusts thresholds, morphology filters, custom masks, and visual checks before extraction.

output_examples.input: I need complete tissue coverage for spatial analysis.
output_examples.output: A GridTiler strategy with level selection, overlap settings, tissue filtering, storage planning, and quality review.

best_practices: Preview thumbnails, masks, and tile locations before extraction.
Set seeds, output folders, and reports so datasets remain reproducible.
Validate tile quality for tissue coverage, blur, artifacts, and staining variation.
anti_patterns: Extracting tiles at level 0 from every slide before checking resource needs.
Using one tissue threshold across stains without visual validation.
Treating tile scores as clinical labels without expert review.

faq.question: Does this skill process my images automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and example workflows for histolab. The user or agent must run code in the local environment.

faq.question: Which WSI formats are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance mentions SVS, TIFF, NDPI, and other formats supported through histolab and OpenSlide.

faq.question: Does it support deep learning dataset preparation?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers random, grid, and score-based tile extraction for training and analysis datasets.

faq.question: Can it remove annotations or artifacts?
faq.answer: It explains custom masks and preprocessing filters that can reduce pen marks, folds, and background artifacts.

faq.question: Is it a diagnostic tool?
faq.answer: No. It supports image preprocessing and data preparation. It does not provide clinical diagnosis.

faq.question: What should I check before extraction?
faq.answer: Check slide dimensions, pyramid levels, tissue masks, tile placement, available storage, and memory requirements.
